description: This file implements a thread-unsafe, auto-closeable SLF4J logger with MDC management and concurrency exception handling.

classes.name: DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger
classes.description: A thread-unsafe, auto-closeable logger that manages MDC entries and delegates logging calls to an SLF4J Logger.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultAutoCloseableSlf4jLogger with a non-null SLF4J Logger.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the underlying SLF4J logger.

methods.name: isTraceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if trace level logging is enabled.

methods.name: trace
methods.description: Logs a trace message if enabled, with MDC context management.

methods.name: setCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID in MDC.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from MDC.

methods.name: putMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates an MDC entry with key and value.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Removes all local MDC entries from the actual MDC and clears local MDC storage.
